notes:
- Account wants predictable unit costs and hard latency SLOs for customer-facing chat.
- Baseline metrics (from their telemetry sample): steady-state QPS 25, average tokens per response 400 (350-800 distribution), baseline tokens/sec ~10k.
- Peak planning: 5x spike planning recommended (peak simulated QPS target 125). They see multi-region bursts during EMEA morning and NA evening.
- Initial model family preference: open-weight Llama3-style variants for cost control; want fallbacks to higher-capacity variants during SLA-critical paths.
- Latency targets: p50 <80ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens), p95 <250ms for typical chat (<=512 tokens). Will accept p95 350ms if compensated with capacity credits in SLA.
- Throughput guarantee ask: predictable sustained throughput for 200k tokens/min, plus burst capacity to 1M tokens/min for 10-minute windows.
- SE notes: KV cache reuse expected for repeated context across conversations — estimated 15% token savings.
- Preliminary reserved GPU estimate discussed in workshop prep: 4 x H100-equivalent for steady-state with autoscale burst pool of 2 additional nodes; quantization & batching could reduce base reserve by ~20%.
- Roofing decision: customer prefers a 3-year commit if we provide clear cost-down milestones at 12/24 months and an exit CLA for priority support.
- Security: must pass EU data residency addendum; prefer KMS keys managed by customer. Audit log retention requested 1 year.
- "Quotes from CTO": "We need hard guarantees on per-route latency and clear fallbacks; intermittent tail latency has caused support SLA misses." 
- Next: run lab microbenchmarks during workshop (QPS sweep and token/sec scaling), finalize model variant latency profiles, produce draft SLA with credit tiers and runbook for fallback to hosted spare capacity.
